purpose: Teach: 洗剤/ひとまず/ナイス/プチ/デカ/ポチ/ダッシュ/バッチリ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、洗濯洗剤、いい香り、するね。
lines.en: Mom, the laundry detergent smells really nice.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely curious observation. Quick breath before "detergent." No expectation of response — just noticing something small out loud. Warm and present.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。今日は、ひとまず、宿題、終わらせようね。
lines.en: Yeah. For now, let's just get your homework done today, okay?
lines.style: Gentle redirect. Not dismissive of his comment, but gently steering. Warm undercurrent — her attention is on him even as she's managing the moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お友達、運動会で、ナイスなプレー、見せた!
lines.en: My friend showed some really cool moves at the sports day!
lines.style: Sudden brightness. Sits up in the energy of the memory. Quick pace, almost tumbling over the words. Pride in his friend, not himself — he's noticing what someone else did well.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: プチカップケーキ、おやつにしようね。
lines.en: We can have some little cupcakes for snack.
lines.style: Soft-sweet offer. Slight lift at the end — not a question, but an opening. She's rewarding his good news without making a production of it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 公園のジャングルジム、デカい!
lines.en: The jungle gym at the park is so big!
lines.style: Genuine awe, almost reverent. Quieter than the previous energy. He's remembering the size of it, the feeling of it. Small wonder in his voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うちのワンちゃん、ポチって、皆呼んでくれる。
lines.en: Our dog Pochi — everyone calls him that.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. She's noticing something tender about how the world includes her son's small attachments. Quiet satisfaction. Not performing, just observing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 授業終わってからダッシュで、塾、走る!
lines.en: Right after class I'm going to dash straight to cram school!
lines.style: Sudden burst of momentum. Quick intake of breath before the run. He's energized, maybe a little proud of his own determination. Brief, snappy — the energy of movement itself.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 準備、バッチリにしておこうね。
lines.en: Let's make sure you're all set and ready to go, okay?
lines.style: Warm closing. Practical and calm, matching rhythm to his earlier energy. She's containing, organizing, making it safe. A small promise that she has this handled.
